T: With great snacks comes great responsibility.
D: A bitten teenager becomes Spider-Man and faces the Green Goblin.
P: Serve the snacks at the wrestling match where Peter wins his first prize money.
S: Bone Saw egg and cheese rolls
three minutes in the ring, then breakfast

Soft rolls with fried eggs, melted American cheese and a shake of salt, pepper and hot sauce, wrapped in foil the way the corner bodega does it. Split 4 soft rolls and toast lightly. Fry 8 eggs in 20g butter, breaking the yolks, and lay 2 slices American cheese over each pair to melt. Stack into the rolls with salt, pepper and a dash of hot sauce, wrap each in foil for 2 minutes so it all steams together.
turkey and cranberry for the awkward Osborn dinner
Slider buns toasted, warm sliced roast turkey, a spoon of cranberry sauce and a crisp square of baked stuffing in each.
Chilled risotto rolled into balls around a cube of mozzarella, floured, egged and crumbed, fried at 175C until deep gold.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in chipotle and lime, grilled and sliced, in warm tortillas with shredded cabbage and sour cream whisked with lime.
Turkey breast brined overnight, roasted at 170C to 70C, rested. Stuffing baked alongside, gravy from the pan juices, roast potato and pumpkin.
W: Uncle Ben's advice, served with syrup

Buttermilk batter rested 15 minutes, cooked in butter until bubbles set, stacked and drowned in maple syrup. Whisk 250g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Add 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 40g melted butter and rest 15 minutes. Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan over medium heat until bubbles set, then flip. Stack high and pour over 150ml maple syrup.
K: J. Jonah wants pictures, you want a drink

Lime juice and cherry syrup over ice, topped with soda water and a cherry. Squeeze 4 limes. Into each of 4 tall glasses of ice pour 30ml lime juice and 30ml cherry syrup, top with 200ml soda water, stir once and drop in a maraschino cherry and a lime wedge.

steps.text: Split the rolls and toast lightly.
Fry the eggs in the butter, breaking the yolks, and lay two slices of cheese over each pair to melt.
Stack the eggs into the rolls with salt, pepper and a dash of hot sauce.
Wrap each roll in foil for a couple of minutes so it all steams together.

dishes.make_ahead: Stuffing squares up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Make the stuffing mix as the packet says and press into a tray.
Bake at 190C until crisp, then cut into 8 squares.
Toast the slider buns and warm the turkey. Fill each bun with turkey, cranberry sauce and a square of stuffing.

veg.n: Thanksgiving sliders with maple roast pumpkin
veg.make_ahead: Stuffing squares and pumpkin up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Make the stuffing mix as the packet says and press into a tray. Peel the pumpkin, slice it thinly and toss with the oil and maple syrup on a second tray.
Bake both at 190C until the stuffing is crisp and the pumpkin is tender, then cut the stuffing into 8 squares.
Toast the slider buns. Fill each bun with pumpkin, cranberry sauce and a square of stuffing.
Stir the salt into the water and brine the turkey breast, covered, in the fridge.
Brine the turkey overnight.
Pat the turkey dry, rub with butter and cut the potatoes and pumpkin into chunks.
Roast the turkey at 170C until 70C inside, with the potato and pumpkin roasting alongside.
Rest the turkey, covered. Bake the stuffing mix as the packet says.
Make gravy from the pan juices, flour and stock. Slice the turkey and serve with everything.

veg.make_ahead: Gravy up to 2 days ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Bring the water and salt to the boil, trim the cauliflower leaves and boil it whole for 6 minutes, then drain and dry.
Toss the potatoes and pumpkin with the oil on a roasting tray.
Mash 40g of the butter with the paprika and garlic and rub all over the cauliflower.
Roast the cauliflower on the tray with the potato and pumpkin until deep golden and tender to a skewer.
Rest the cauliflower, covered. Bake the stuffing mix as the packet says.
Melt the remaining butter in a pan, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer into a gravy. Cut the cauliflower into wedges and serve with everything.

dishes.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Add the eggs, buttermilk and some melted butter.
Rest the batter.
Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan over medium heat until bubbles set, then flip. Keep the stack warm.
Stack high and pour over the maple syrup.
Squeeze 4 limes and cut the last into wedges.
Into each of 4 tall glasses of ice pour the lime juice and cherry syrup, top with soda water, stir once and drop in a cherry and a lime wedge.

s.note: Mini rolls of roast turkey, cranberry sauce and crisp stuffing.
s.how: Make a 170g stuffing mix as the packet says, press into a tray and bake at 190C for 25 minutes until crisp, then cut into 8 squares. Toast 8 slider buns. Fill each with 300g warm sliced roast turkey in total, a spoon of cranberry sauce and a square of stuffing.

m.note: Brined roast turkey breast with stuffing, gravy, potato and pumpkin.
m.how: Brine a 1.2kg turkey breast overnight in 2 litres water with 100g salt. Pat dry, rub with butter and roast at 170C to 70C inside, about 75 minutes. Rest 15 minutes. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin in chunks alongside. Bake a 170g stuffing mix. Make gravy from the pan juices, 2 tbsp flour and 400ml chicken stock.
